tradeoff_analysis.predictive_accuracy_vs_governance: Configuration B (Raw Phase 14 SLM) achieves slightly higher raw accuracy (98.75% vs 96.25%) on synthetic contrastive templates because it mirrors statistical label distributions. However, Configuration D (Full E5 with Policy Engine) enforces deterministic enterprise governance: when operational indicators (e.g. active security compromise or complete pool exhaustion) are detected, the policy guarantees P1/P2 elevation with immutable audit reason codes regardless of model sampling randomness.
